import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
# robust check for potassium
m = smf.ols('yield_kg ~ potassium_ppm + C(farm)', data=df).fit(cov_type='HC3')
print("HC3:", m.params['potassium_ppm'], m.pvalues['potassium_ppm'])
# bootstrap
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
coefs=[]
for _ in range(2000):
    s=df.sample(len(df),replace=True)
    mm=smf.ols('yield_kg ~ potassium_ppm + C(farm)', data=s).fit()
    coefs.append(mm.params['potassium_ppm'])
coefs=np.array(coefs)
print("boot mean",coefs.mean(),"2.5/97.5",np.percentile(coefs,[2.5,97.5]))
